Desktop (Literally) Building Construction

Andy CASA, UCL East

Tecton Limited - a value-added partner in the real estate and construction cluster. Have placed an interesting video on YouTube of a building being virtually constructed on a desktop. The same thing could be carried out using basic Augmented Reality - see our 'Desktop (Literally) Augmented Reality' post for more info - nevertheless its interesting how construction firms are looking into such visualisation techniques:



Take a look at their website for more examples.
